rules.when: every queue has at least one value
then: dequeue one from each and emit the tuple

rules.given: the completing input's queue is empty
then: complete, because no further tuple is possible

rules.given: the completing input's queue still holds values
then: keep emitting tuples while its queue drains
complete as soon as its queue is empty
